runtime_dependency_gap.instructions: Can either bundled MCP server still require repository node_modules or a system-installed node executable when launched inside the packaged Electron app? Evaluate explicit external runtime packages, copied dependency closure, and process.execPath/ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE.

python_path_gap.instructions: Will bundled Blender executor __dirname/python/runner.py be missing given the build copy to local/dist/python and collected resource destination? Note the executor uses path.resolve(__dirname, python, runner.py).

false_customer_claim.instructions: Does this package verification impersonate authentication, seed product state, mock services, or claim that a real customer rendered a video? It is explicitly package/protocol verification using genuine isolated processes.

packaged_resource_gap.instructions: Can electron-builder silently omit an entire MCP resource directory and still pass the shown afterPack verification? Evaluate copied actual resource paths and MCP real-process checks.
